elements.label: AI composer input expanding to hold attachment

elements.manual_reason: 'Draft anything...' suggestion row disappears on drop; it is absent from the end frame so no candidate box covers it
elements.label: Draft anything suggestion row removed

pattern.description: A PDF file icon is dragged from the left of the page across into the Notion AI composer; on drop the composer snaps taller, the 'Draft anything...' row disappears, an RFP_Sept2024.pdf attachment pill appears inside the input with an 'All sources' selector, and typing begins.
pattern.why_premium: The drag gives a physical, readable cause for the state change, and the drop resolves in a single clean frame swap so the attachment lands with no lag; the first typed character immediately hands off to the next beat.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.file-icon', {x: dropX, y: dropY, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); then at drop: tl.set('.file-icon', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.draft-row', {display: 'none'}).set('.composer', {height: expandedH}).fromTo('.attach-chip', {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.96}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<').fromTo('.all-sources', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.12}, '<'); then a TextPlugin/steps typing of the prompt starting ~0.1s after.
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate the file icon x/y over ~27 frames at 30fps with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad); at the drop frame switch composer state (taller height, chip + 'All sources' visible, draft row hidden) with a 3-4 frame opacity fade on the chip; then reveal prompt chars with Math.floor(interpolate(frame, ...)) slicing.

notes: Drop is a near-instant state swap (single-frame energy spike near f821) rather than an animated expand. b03 is the diff box at the file icon's start position; the icon is absent from the end frame. b02 covers both the composer and suggestion rows; chosen as the closest box for the composer reflow. Removal chip close button (b15) is part of the attachment chip and not listed separately. No SFX candidates in packet.
